turns.assessment: The initiating fault is at the S10→S19 booster: amp0 raised AMP_FAIL while its input power remained unchanged and its output disappeared. The downstream amplifiers then lost input/output, while the reverse S19→S10 line remained normal. This rules strongly against an input-patch disconnection or fibre cut and identifies a hard booster pump/unit failure affecting svc154's working path.

proposals.rationale: oms.S10-S19.amp0 had a simultaneous AMP_FAIL and loss of output despite unchanged input power. Every downstream amplifier then lost signal, exactly matching loss of all channels after a booster pump failure.
A pulled OMS input patch could interrupt all channels, but amp0 input power showed no change and amp0 itself raised AMP_FAIL, strongly contradicting this cause.
A cut in the first span could cause downstream loss, but it should not remove amp0 output or produce AMP_FAIL at amp0; the unaffected reverse direction also weighs against the usual cable cut.
